title: Canotto dough
description: The dough itself, as baker's percentages against total flour, plus the batch size and the flour blend.

method.description: Only biga is supported. The field exists so a reader can tell.

ballWeight.description: Weight of one ball, in grams.

frozenBalls.description: How many of them go to the freezer. Above zero, the freeze buffer is added to the inoculation.

wastePct.description: Extra dough mixed to cover losses.

hydrationPct.description: Total water as a percentage of total flour.

yeastType.description: Instant dry, active dry, or fresh. Relative potency is 1 : 1.25 : 3.

baseYeastPct.description: Inoculation before any freeze buffer, in the chosen yeast type.

freezeBufferPct.description: Added to the inoculation only when frozenBalls is above zero, to cover cells lost to freezing.

prefermentFlourPct.description: Share of total flour that goes into the biga.

prefermentHydrationPct.description: Water in the biga as a percentage of biga flour. Traditionally 44 to 45.

prefermentYeastShare.description: Fraction of the total yeast that goes into the biga rather than the final mix.

saltWashShare.description: Fraction of the final mix water held back to wash the salt in.

bassinageDoses.description: How many additions the bassinage water is split into.

flours.description: The blend. Shares are percentages and should total 100.
